description: Kevin's Desk: who owns the private /kd/<link> page, its random link, and the Gmail mailboxes it reads. Only the desk owner can change the owner, the mailboxes or the Google App, or turn the page off.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: When off, the page and its endpoints answer 404 for everyone.

fields.label: Desk Owner
fields.description: The only user who can open the page. Must be an enabled System User.

fields.label: Link Slug
fields.description: The page lives at /kd/<slug>. Clear it and save to get a new random link (the old one stops working).

fields.label: Google App
fields.description: The site's Google Connected App. Each mailbox gets its own copy (kevins-desk-<name>) with offline access; this one is not changed.

fields.label: Connecting
fields.options: Connect each mailbox from the desk page (Mailboxes card). Before the first connect, add each mailbox's redirect URI, shown on that card, to the Google OAuth client's Authorized redirect URIs.

name: ilL-Desk-Settings
